authority_basis.summary: Reporting an exact obstruction to reconstructing the active K5 adapter from the lower quadratic coordinate grade.

operations.title: Benincasa finds that the graph functional does not descend to the quadratic grade
operations.body: Exact augmentation test: the 26 quadratic-coordinate rows have rank 18, but adjoining the block-one graph-functional value raises rank to 19. Therefore the graph functional does not factor through Entry 1060's 18-dimensional quadratic-coordinate image. Equivalently, the two tangentwise functionals disagree on the 8-dimensional coordinate overlap. The K5 adapter must act on the labelled residual module itself; an adapter reconstructed only from quadratic coordinates necessarily loses one bit of extension/graph data. This is independent of the pending target map.
